map.气体反应平衡常数换算: Converting equilibrium constants for gas reactions
map.输入 Kc、温度与气体摩尔数变化 Δn，求 Kp（R=8.314，T 为开尔文）: Enter Kc, the temperature and the change in gas moles Δn to get Kp, with R = 8.314 and T in kelvin.
map.📖 查看「气体反应平衡常数换算 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Converting equilibrium constants for gas reactions"
map.📚 深度解析：气体反应平衡常数换算: 📚 Deep Dive: Converting equilibrium constants for gas reactions
map.Kp↔Kc 互算：给定 Kc、T 与 Δn（气体计量差）求 Kp。: Converting Kp to Kc and back: given Kc, T and Δn, the gas stoichiometric difference, find Kp.
map.Δn 判定：由反应式气体计量系数差定 Δn 符号，影响换算方向。: Determining Δn: the sign of Δn follows the difference between the gas stoichiometric coefficients in the reaction equation and sets the direction of the conversion.
map.温度影响：RT 项随 T 变化，提示 Kp 与 Kc 一般不等。: Temperature effect: the RT term varies with T, which is why Kp and Kc generally differ.
map.输入 Kc=0.5、T=298K、Δn=1，工具输出 Kp≈12.3（RT≈24: Enter Kc = 0.5, T = 298 K and Δn = 1 and the tool gives Kp ≈ 12.3 with RT ≈ 24.6 L·atm/mol, noting that Kp = Kc when Δn = 0.
map.生成气体计量和减反应气体计量和；无气体或相等则 Δn=0，Kp=Kc。: It is the sum of the gas stoichiometric coefficients of the products minus that of the reactants; with no gas or equal amounts Δn = 0 and Kp = Kc.
map.与 P 单位匹配：P 用 atm 取 0.0821 L·atm/(mol·K)；: Match it to the pressure unit: 0.0821 L·atm/(mol·K) when P is in atm, or 8.314 when it is in Pa.
map.Kp 和 Kc 量纲一样吗？: Do Kp and Kc have the same dimensions?
map.数值与量纲不同（因 (RT)^Δn 带单位），不可直接比大小。: The values and dimensions differ, since (RT)^Δn carries units, so they cannot be compared directly.
